name: Jellycap
description: Plays a short recap before an episode (Android TV friendly).
overview: Builds a recap video from previous episodes (and from the already-watched part of a resumed episode) with ffmpeg, then tells the Android TV client to play it before the episode.
changelog: 1.1.0.0: Text cards on the JellyXR TV app overlay. When the JellyXR TV app (1.1.0 or newer) runs on the box, Text recaps pause the episode and show the cards over the player instead of playing a video, and Both recaps play the clips with the cards on top. Setting: Show text cards with the JellyXR TV app (default on).
